description.text:
The Squirtle deck from the Japanese Intro Pack, a two-player box meant to teach newcomers, released on 30 July 1999 with a VHS video. It held two 41-card half decks, one led by Bulbasaur and one by Squirtle, with a Chansey coin, damage counters, markers, a rule book and a playmat.

The deck's cards are numbered in a small circle at the bottom right, well before Pokémon VS became the first Japanese expansion to number its cards. Some, such as Wartortle and Arcanine, have artwork found only in this box, and Bill's Teleporter first appeared here. The 41st card is an unnumbered holo Blastoise by Ken Sugimori, marked with a Squirtle symbol.
